## LLM019 Blocking call inside a @Tool method

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm019 |
| Turn it off | `LLM019: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM019` on the command line |

Tool calls run on the request thread. A database lookup, a synchronous HTTP call or even a sleep inside the tool means the model sits there waiting: it looks like a slow model, but it is waiting for your tool. Fetch what the tool needs beforehand, or have the tool hand off the work and return right away.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM019` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm019 -->

## What it looks like

An `@Tool` method calling a repository, a blocking HTTP client, `Thread.sleep`, or `Future.get()`.

## How to fix

Keep tools fast: hand off to an async job or a cache and return quickly. The model waits for the tool on the request thread.
